digest.component_or_area: gate dispatch sidecar (plan/code-review and completion gates)
propositions: On the gates' infrastructure-exception path, additively write a gate_error_v1 sidecar record with verdict=ERROR and an error{cause,evidence_ref} object so an env-diagnosis interval start is recorded by gate code rather than agent self-report.
Plan-review and code-review gates must emit the ERROR record then still return their existing degraded INDETERMINATE verdict, preserving the soft-degrade contract.
The completion gate must emit the ERROR record then re-raise the LLMUnavailableError, preserving the fail-closed contract.
Use a dedicated gate_error_v1 schema and builder that bypasses reconcile_verdict so the ERROR verdict is not coerced to FAIL, written on existing REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT event types.
A domain BLOCK/FAIL (non-infra outcome) writes no gate_error_v1 record.
Existing verdict readers (latest_review_result, latest_fail_verdict) skip gate_error_v1 via schema guards and never surface the ERROR record.
